entry_state: About five metres up at the far end of the grass pitch, seen from just behind, the white airplane glides to the right over the crowded black chair blocks in front of the stage, toward the row of white booth tents on the right long side of the red track.
beats: Continuing the reference video without any cut, at the same low height, the airplane finishes its slow curve around the far end and flies back along the RIGHT long side of the red track over the row of white booth tents full of students, toward the school, gradually lowering to just above head height. The camera stays about two metres behind it.

Past the near-right corner of the track it keeps gliding in one wide, smooth leftward arc, never turning back sharply: over the road in front of the green air arch and across the wide open lawn block, toward the WEST end of the food-truck lot.

Still turning gently left, it glides EASTWARD along the straight row of six colourful food trucks, a few metres above the students queuing in front of them; all six trucks stay the same throughout. It does not fly toward the school building.

At the end of the truck row it crosses the straight road and curves gently left, gliding along the road past the parked bus and trucks, then over the lawn on the track side of that road where students lounge on red, green and orange bean bags, seen only from above and behind.

From the bean bags it curves gently left along the track fence to the green inflatable air arch at the track gate and flies straight through the middle of the arch, well above the head of anyone nearby; the camera passes through right behind it.

Inside the track it rises a little and glides clearly above the crossbar of the single near goal, then low across the grass pitch past the sound booth, above the heads of the many students sitting in the black chair blocks, heading straight for the stage.

Only now does it rise: the airplane climbs smoothly over the white truss roof of the stage and keeps climbing straight up into the deep blue sky; the camera tilts up following it, the frame fills with bright sunlight and glows to pure white.
exit_state: The frame is entirely bright white light.
audio: diegetic only: lively festival ambience (many voices chatting, gentle laughter, food-truck sizzle, footsteps), paper flutter, a rising airy breeze as the light grows.
extra_negatives: no high aerial drone view before the stage
no change of the festival layout
no air arch on the grass
no turning back to look at places already passed
no bean bags on the school side of the road
